The '''68th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary film|documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2015, were presented on February 6, 2016, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Kilday|first1=Gregg|title=2016 DGA Awards: The Complete Winners List|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/2016-dga-winners-complete-list-856953|access-date=January 19, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=February 6, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=68th Annual DGA Awards Winners|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2016/160206-DGA-Awards-Winners.aspx|access-date=January 19, 2018|publisher=Directors Guild of America|date=February 6, 2016}}</ref> [[Jane Lynch]] hosted the ceremony for the third time.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Petski|first1=Denise|title=DGA Awards 2016 Timeline Announced|url=https://deadline.com/2015/07/dga-awards-2016-timeline-directors-guild-1201483472/|website=Deadline Hollywood|access-date=February 8, 2018|date=July 22, 2015}}</ref> The nominees for the feature film categories were announced on January 12, 2016.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Tapley|first1=Kristopher|title=Alejandro G. Inarritu, Tom McCarthy, Adam McKay, George Miller, Ridley Scott Land DGA Nominations|url=https://variety.com/2016/film/in-contention/alejandro-g-inarritu-tom-mccarthy-adam-mckay-george-miller-ridley-scott-land-dga-nominations-1201677599/|access-date=January 12, 2016|work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|date=January 12, 2016|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Feature Film for 2015|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2016/160112-Awards-Feature-Film-Noms.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 19, 2018|date=January 12, 2016}}</ref> The nominations for directing achievements in television, documentaries and commercials were announced on January 13, 2016.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Hipes|first1=Patrick|title=DGA Awards Nominations Set For TV & Documentaries|url=https://deadline.com/2016/01/dga-awards-2016-tv-documentaries-directors-guild-full-list-1201682056/|website=Deadline Hollywood|access-date=January 19, 2018|date=January 13, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2015|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2016/160113-68th-Annual-DGA-Awards-Television-Commercial-and-Documentary-Nominees-Announced.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 19, 2018|date=January 13, 2016}}</ref>
